item.title: Friday's inflation report could help Fed decide whether to raise interest rates
item.description: Consumer prices rose 3.4% percent last month from a year ago, the same as it was in July and matching expectations. Gas prices were among the biggest risers.

item.title: Why gains by Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen could push gas prices even higher
item.description: A Houthi advance along Yemen's Red Sea coast could help push gas prices up even more as the Iran-backed group also launches attacks on Saudi Arabia's oil facilities.

item.title: Crude oil tops $100 a barrel, increasing prices at the pump
item.description: An escalation of fighting around the Strait of Hormuz pushes the benchmark price of crude oil back above $100 per barrel. That's leading to higher prices at the gas pump, just ahead of a high-profile inflation report.

item.title: Farmers fear more damage from U.S.-Canada trade fight
item.description: The Trump administration's escalating trade war with one of the U.S.'s closest allies, Canada, is causing economic anxiety in rural border states like Montana, which counts Canada as its main export market.

item.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
item.description: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

item.title: U.S. employers added 162,000 jobs in August, beating expectations
item.description: U.S. employers added 162,000 jobs in August, beating expectations. The news could give the Federal Reserve more leeway to raise interest rates later this month to curb stubborn inflation.
